instruction_text: Speak directly to one listener with warmth and a smile in your voice; calm, steady and reassuring, like a favorite morning radio host, while keeping the news clear and credible.
asr_text: For example, you can continue an official story on the service, or you can make your own story as a fan. What if that person came here? If it were me, I'd want to see this happen. The ideas that grew as you turned each page can now start your own stories. You may wait to see what happens next, or you may use that time to think up what happens next. You can also publish your fan stories, if you want to. You can keep them private, or let someone else read them. But things change when you make a story public. Will people understand the story? I wanna think a little more about what happens next. Before you know it, you may think like a story maker, though you began as a reader.
